item.title: Cassidy takes historic pole as Evans stars in Jaguar Madrid one-two race victory - VelocityNews
item.description: Nick Cassidy secures a historic Formula E pole position for Citroën Racing in Madrid, but a dramatic race sees Mitch Evans finish second in a Jaguar one-two as Cassidy falls to 17th.

item.title: Martin makes his move as Hampton Downs delivers a flawless opening day - VelocityNews
item.description: Grant Martin storms to Race 1 victory at Hampton Downs in the NZ F5000 Tasman Cup Revival finale, while Anna Collins extends her championship lead heading into Sunday’s decider.

item.title: Hedge secures debut podium in Porsche Carrera Cup North America at Sebring - VelocityNews
item.description: Callum Hedge delivers an impressive debut in Porsche Carrera Cup North America at Sebring, securing a podium finish and strong championship start.

item.title: McElrea stars as United Autosports seal LMP2 victory in Sebring thriller, Bamber and Dixon narrowly miss out on GTP podium - VelocityNews
item.description: Hunter McElrea secures his first 12 Hours of Sebring LMP2 victory as United Autosports claim a stunning one-two finish in a dramatic IMSA showdown.

item.title: Hawkeswood dominates and wins Possum Bourne Memorial Rally - VelocityNews
item.description: Jack Hawkeswood dominates the 2026 Possum Bourne Memorial Rally, winning four stages to secure victory ahead of Quentin Palmer, as the North Island Rally Series kicks off on iconic Te Akau roads.

item.title: Martin’s perfect weekend crowns Collins and Annabell as 2025/26 F5000 title winners at Hampton Downs - VelocityNews
item.description: The season finale of the F5000 series was held over the weekend at Hampton Downs, where a closely fought season came to a close.

item.title: Buchanan battles through pain to finish Brazil GP - VelocityNews
item.description: Cormac Buchanan has had to battle through pain after a nasty crash to finish P18 at the Moto3 Brazil Grand Prix.

item.title: McLean strong at Ruapuna but challengers remain in touch - VelocityNews
item.description: A 32 car SS Cup field provided fierce racing at Euromarque Motorsport Park, where a tight championship battle is starting to form.

item.title: Stellar line-up promises exciting Popotunoa Rallysprint - VelocityNews
item.description: A star-studded line-up promises a very exciting Popotunoa Rallysprint, which takes place on Saturday, 28th of March.

item.title: Taranaki Jetsprints deliver nail-biting finale - VelocityNews
item.description: The final round of the 2026 New Zealand Jetsprint Championships proved to be a closely contested battle, with accuracy from drivers rewarded with results.

item.title: Game on at Mazda Racing Super Series Finale - VelocityNews
item.description: The Mazda Racing Super Series heads to Taupō for a thrilling 2025/2026 finale, with three drivers separated by just four points in a dramatic championship showdown.

item.title: All on the line for NZ Formula Ford Championship title this weekend in Taupo - VelocityNews
item.description: All eyes on Taupo as the NZ Formula Ford Championship title goes down to the wire. Four races remain with ten drivers still in contention for the 2025/26 crown.

item.title: Strong entry for opening 2026 Mainland Rally Championship round in Westland - VelocityNews
item.description: The 2026 Mainland Rally Championship kicks off with a strong Westland Rally field, featuring top drivers, fast gravel stages and over 100km of action.
